messages:
maria: Quick sync after the postmortem for the Rate Limiter regression. We need clear owners and deadlines for customer-facing items: status page wording, 72h external summary, and RCA sharing policy (redaction/consent). Also call out recurring incident signals we should mention externally. Who can pick what?

ben: I can own the status page patch. I'll draft concise text + a one-line TL;DR and note SLO impact. Goal: Fri EOD. Will drop draft here for quick reviews. @liz can you do tone/legal check?

liz: Yep, I'll review. Aim to respond within 24h of your draft. Suggest we avoid words like "outage" if the service degraded but remained available; use "partial degradation" or "brief throttling". Also will flag any data that legal recommends redacting.

sam: I'll handle the RCA sharing policy follow-up. Tasks: define who gets what level of RCA (public summary vs. detailed), propose redaction rules for internal identifiers, and sketch a consent flow for customers requesting full detail. Target: Wed COB.

jordan: I'll take recurring-incident analysis. There are a few similar throttling incidents in the last quarter. I'll add a short paragraph for the 72h summary about the mitigation plan addressing the pattern and link to the internal remediation tracker. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: Great. I've added initial deliverables to the action tracker inside the postmortem doc: ```- Statuspage copy 14 owner: ben 14 due: 2026-03-27 EOD
- 72h external summary 14 owner: liz/jordan 14 due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC
- RCA sharing policy & consent flow 14 owner: sam 14 due: 2026-03-25 COB
- Remediation plan update 14 owner: eng-sre 14 due: 2026-04-02"```

ben: Draft status page copy now: ```We experienced a brief increase in request throttles (429 responses) caused by a misapplied quota routing rule. Impact: approximately 3% of requests for ~12 minutes. Mitigation: traffic reroute and hotfix deployed. Next steps: permanent quota routing fix and additional observability. Updates: incidents@redwood.com.``` Feedback welcome.

liz: Minor suggestion: avoid internal timing granularities in the public copy; "brief" is fine. Add a link to the live status page and a short "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" bullet list. Also, remove customer-identifying details per legal.

sam: Legal asks we do not name customers in any public text. For detailed RCA access we'll require an explicit consent form and will redact customer IDs unless the customer provides permission. I'll draft consent language: short checkbox + contact email.

sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker entry: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1#actions

maria: For the 72h summary include an "impact matrix" (who was affected, what happened, duration), the mitigation steps, and a single POC for customer follow-ups. Make sure the recurring-incident paragraph references the internal audit schedule.

jordan: Uploaded the pattern analysis and linked it in the doc. Finding: similar misrouting logic change was present in 2 of 3 incidents; recommend a targeted audit of routing policy changes and a short rollout checklist. I'll add suggested language for the external summary.

ben: I'll update the draft per comments and set POC = incidents@redwood.com. New draft will avoid specific internal metrics.

liz: Looks good to me after those edits. No blocking concerns.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll set calendar reminders and nudge 24h before each due date. If anyone needs to swap ownership, post here. :spiral_calendar:
